svg.aria-label: Space Drums architecture. A strike travels from webcam capture through perception of hand landmarks or red stick tips, a causal per-hand tracker, stroke and zone geometry and a commit state machine into the audio sample bank, while prediction feeds commit without ever importing geometry. Twelve import layers are enforced by import-linter: all seven contracts kept, zero broken, across 198 files and 564 dependencies. Two input modes: bare-hand fingertips and red-tip sticks.
svg.title: Space Drums architecture
svg.text: Webcam air drumming with causal strike detection and live audio
PYTHON 3.11 · OPENCV · MEDIAPIPE · PYTORCH · LIGHTGBM · SOUNDDEVICE
CURRENT-FRAME CAUSALITY · ONE MONOTONIC CLOCK · PER-HAND INDEPENDENCE
feeds commit directly · never imports geometry (no-peek)
